breakdown.description: A vacancy–interstitial pair on the same ionic sublattice is a Frenkel defect, not a Schottky defect.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly identified a cation vacancy and cation interstitial pair as a Schottky defect. The generated specification correctly identifies this as a Frenkel defect, and even goes on to explain the difference between a Frenkel and a Schottky defect, thus resolving the factual error.
